bear_assumptions: USD 18 normalized EPS at 12x as cracks normalize quickly, Port Arthur or other outages recur, Benicia costs persist, compliance and turnaround spending rise, and working capital reverses.
base_assumptions: USD 22 normalized EPS at 13x as regional margins settle above trough levels, throughput remains reliable, sustaining costs are funded, renewable fuels contribute, and balance-sheet flexibility persists.
bull_assumptions: USD 27 normalized EPS at 14x as product constraints persist longer, regional diesel cracks remain elevated, operations stay reliable, St. Charles optimization contributes, and capital returns remain disciplined.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh normalized scenarios clear confidence-adjusted expected return, base upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates while throughput, sustaining investment, working capital and leverage remain sound; downgrade if cracks normalize faster, outages recur, turnaround or compliance costs rise, working capital reverses, leverage increases, or capital returns impair resilience.
